request.query: view, limit (canonical decimal integer), cursor; no body or trusted identity fields
request.parent: server validates an authorized unarchived channel in the trusted tenant

cursor.encoding: unpadded base64url of UTF-8 JSON with fields in the order below; reject noncanonical encodings
cursor.scope: parentConversationId and resolved view; limit may change; tenant/actor/access are always reauthorized from the session, never from a cursor
cursor.order: thread.createdAt normalized/truncated to UTC milliseconds descending, thread.id ascending by UTF-8 bytes (database C collation); exclusive continuation using the same normalized keys
cursor.consistency: immutable creation keys avoid activity reordering; live pages recheck access/archive/lifecycle and current policy/time, not a frozen snapshot
cursor.invalid: reject malformed, oversized, unknown-version, wrong-parent or wrong-view cursors; never silently restart

response.thread: ThreadConversationSnapshotSummary from conversation-snapshot-runtime.ts / ConversationSnapshotSummary containing canonical ThreadConversation in Dart
response.follow: NonNullable<ConversationDetailSnapshotConversation['currentThreadFollow']>; canonical follow state, null only at revision zero
response.lifecycle: canonical optional ThreadLifecycle from contracts/models/conversation.json; absent means legacy open/unlocked
response.timestamps: discovery evaluatedAt, lastActivityAt and cursor/summary createdAt use canonical four-digit-year UTC ISO with exactly millisecond precision
response.hideAt: null when policy absent/false; otherwise finite Unix milliseconds = lastActivityAt epoch milliseconds + hideAfterMs (fractional positive durations supported without rounding)
response.validation: reject unknown envelope/item/thread fields, invalid canonical summaries/follows, parent mismatch, archived threads, duplicate IDs, unsorted or non-advancing pages, excess items, invalid expiry or empty-thread activity, active hidden/closed entries; nextCursor must describe the last item of a nonempty full page

inactivity.resolvedPolicy: false | { hideAfterMs: positive finite number }; absent is disabled
inactivity.resolution: only after trusted tenant and parent authorization; invalid configuration/results and resolver errors disable hiding
inactivity.activity: latest actual persisted thread message created_at, falling back to thread created_at only for an empty thread; never conversation.updated_at; summary.activityAt equals lastActivityAt
inactivity.boundary: hidden when elapsed inactivity (evaluatedAt - lastActivityAt) >= hideAfterMs; hideAt is the derived IEEE-754 Unix-millisecond projection, so use elapsed time for comparison to avoid rounding very small positive durations to zero
inactivity.behavior: computed discovery only; no stored hidden flag, lifecycle transition, worker, scheduler or write; a user reply-style preference never enables shared hiding

eligibility.active: authorized, parent/thread unarchived, open (absent lifecycle is open/unlocked), and before enabled hideAt
eligibility.all: includes authorized hidden/closed discoverable history; never bypass parent/thread archive, tenant, entity or access policy
eligibility.independence: follow, unread, notification preference, membership and access are independent; no follow or invitation-only private-thread requirement; private parent access remains required; reads must not materialize membership/follow/read/preference rows
eligibility.capability: lifecycleSupported is server authority, not caller input; false rejects lifecycle metadata and preserves legacy eligibility; advertise lifecycle-dependent discovery/controls only once shared persistence, hydration and enforcement support the semantics; do not infer support from user style or a model parser

transport.failures: transport failures stay errors; malformed responses throw, never become an empty page
transport.implementation: contract only; SQL, routing, client/UI and handshake rollout belong to later items
